invite_list.method: GET invitations/ (router basename workspace-invitations under workspaces/<slug>/; urls/invite.py)

responses.200: bare JSON ARRAY (never paginated) of WorkspaceInviteSerializer (views/invite.py:55-58)

invite_patch.method: PATCH invitations/<pk>/ (partial_update; PUT maps to DRF update -> 405 — viewset defines partial_update only)

body.error: Email cannot be updated after invite is created.

400_email.when: request carries ANY email key (views/invite.py:114-118) — even the unchanged address

invites.auth: WorkspaceOwnerPermission (ws ADMIN only) on every action (views/invite.py:32-34)
invites.note: Router-generated paths: list+create at invitations/, retrieve/partial_update/destroy at invitations/<pk>/ (DefaultRouter, urls/invite.py). Trailing slash required by the router.

me.method: GET users/me/ (urls/user.py; auth: IsAuthenticated default only — any valid token)

responses.200: 7-key UserLite shape {id, first_name, last_name, email, avatar, avatar_url, display_name} (pinned by contract test_me_shape)

body.detail: Given API token is not valid

responses.201: {id, member, role} (views/member.py:152-156); validation 400s keyed by field (member/role) per serializers/collab.golden.json

responses.204: empty; is_active flipped False, ROW KEPT (views/member.py:218-222 — explicit flag, not a deleted_at soft-delete)

responses.200: USER profile (UserLite 7 keys), NOT the membership row (views/member.py:175-192 — pinned by contract test_detail_get_patch_delete)

project_member_list.aliases: members/ and project-members/ serve the SAME view class and return IDENTICAL sets (pinned by contract test_project_members_list_aliases); detail aliases likewise (urls/member.py)
project_member_list.method: GET members/ (perm: ProjectMemberPermission — any workspace project row reads)

responses.200: bare JSON ARRAY of UserLite (7 keys each, no role key — contrast workspace list; views/member.py:121-141)
{id, member, role} membership shape (views/member.py:203-208 — contrast detail GET which returns the user)

workspace_members.method: GET workspaces/<slug>/members/ (perm: WorkSpaceAdminPermission — ws ADMIN/MEMBER; views/member.py:31-33)

responses.200: bare JSON ARRAY of UserLite + role key per entry (views/member.py:69-91; key set pinned by contract test_workspace_members_list)
